request.text: Compose original music for Crimson Thread Pilgrimage, a dark fairytale underground action-adventure. Natural acoustic instruments, expressive phrasing, clear voicing, transparent mix with space for gameplay sound effects. No imitation of existing music or named artists, no chiptune, EDM drops, trailer braams or mastering distortion. Shared original Silent Toll motif: D4 down to A3 then up to B-flat3, then a rest; leave it unresolved except in endings A and C. Crimson Thread countertheme: D4 leap to B-flat4, then A4 G4 F4 E4, in plucked timbres. Build toward a cadence, then interrupt at E-flat with one snapped plucked string. A deceptive V to flat-VI, reversed bronze envelopes and whole-tone tide clusters flood in. Many tiny separate wordless voices finally sound independently, freedom resembling a flood, then retreat to a deep slow pulse. No tonic resolution. Only wordless humming or vowel choir as specified; NO intelligible words, lyrics, speech or narration. This is a complete one-shot cue: finish deliberately and let the last resonance decay within the duration.
